title: Design and Install Substation Power Transformer
short_description: Design, manufacture, and deliver three-phase substation power transformers for Weatherford, Texas.
project_scope: Design, manufacture, test, document, and deliver three-phase power transformers with associated supplementary equipment and transformer oil; provide fully functional and operational equipment complete in every detail.
services: Electrical engineering and energy engineering; design and installation of substation power transformer equipment.
relevance_explanation:
- This is an electrical equipment procurement for substation transformers, not a structural or bridge/building design project.
- No indication of structural engineering, lightweight structures, long spans, or architecturally demanding load-bearing systems.
- Falls outside sbp's core focus on bridges, special structures, roofs, facades, and complex building structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost stated in the source. The notice only describes supply/design/installation of three-phase power transformers and associated equipment; no budget, transformer rating, or installation extent is provided, so a realistic estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No planning fee stated in the source. The procurement is primarily for transformer equipment design/manufacture/delivery/installation, so an sbp-specific engineering fee cannot be derived realistically from the available information.
